frame: ECLIPJ2000, centred on the Moon; scene axes are SPICE (x, z, -y)

notes: Positions are geometric (abcorr NONE): no light-time or aberration. Earth and Sun are the DE440s Moon-centred vectors in ECLIPJ2000.
Moon orientation is the rotation MOON_ME_DE440_ME421 to ECLIPJ2000, expressed in scene axes (x, z, -y) as a three.js quaternion.
Earth orientation is IAU_EARTH (pck00011.tpc, low precision, adequate for texture orientation) to ECLIPJ2000 in the same scene axes.

Samples are 2 h apart; the client interpolates positions linearly and quaternions by slerp. Computed over this span, the largest error of linear interpolation of the Earth position at interval midpoints is 20.4 km (stated bound 21 km).
Quaternions are sign-continuous between consecutive samples.
